l4_steps.name: Collect Market Demand Signals
l4_steps.input: Historical booking data, OAG traffic stats, O&D demand reports
l4_steps.output: Demand signal matrix by market/season
l4_steps.pain_point: Demand data lags 6-8 weeks; seasonal spikes under-estimated in LF markets

l4_steps.name: Benchmark Competitor Schedules
l4_steps.input: Competitor SSIM files, OAG flight data
l4_steps.output: Competitive gap analysis by route
l4_steps.pain_point: Competitor schedule changes filed late; OAG refresh lag causes stale data

l4_steps.name: Review Prior-Season Performance
l4_steps.input: Prior PDEW actuals, load factor by flight, revenue per ASM
l4_steps.output: Season performance scorecard
l4_steps.pain_point: Point-to-point metrics mask connection flow; no codeshare data available

l4_steps.name: Define Season Boundary Dates
l4_steps.input: IATA season schedule, slot deadlines, bank holiday calendars
l4_steps.output: Season start/end dates + IATA submission calendar
l4_steps.pain_point: IATA deadlines compress planning window; US holiday variance requires manual overrides

l4_steps.name: Build Draft Flight Schedule
l4_steps.input: Demand matrix, fleet availability plan, crew contract minimums
l4_steps.output: Draft SSIM schedule file with estimated utilisation
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual conflict resolution for shared-gate airports; SkyWORKS UI limits batch-edit

l4_steps.name: Run Network Simulation
l4_steps.input: Draft SSIM, O&D demand, fare levels
l4_steps.output: Projected PDEW, RASM, connection flows by scenario
l4_steps.pain_point: Simulation run time 4-6 hours; limits iterative testing cycles in compressed window

l4_steps.name: Optimise Fleet Assignment
l4_steps.input: Draft schedule, fleet availability, maintenance windows
l4_steps.output: Fleet assignment plan: tail type per flight
l4_steps.pain_point: Single fleet type (737 family) means AD groundings affect 100% of network simultaneously

l4_steps.name: Validate Crew Legal Compliance
l4_steps.input: Fleet assignment, FAR Part 117 rest rules, union CBA minimums
l4_steps.output: Crew feasibility report; flagged violations
l4_steps.kpi: 0 FAR Part 117 violations in final schedule
l4_steps.pain_point: Reserve crew positioning across 8 focus cities constrained; AWS system still stabilising post-Dec 2022 rebuild

l4_steps.name: Check Gate & Slot Availability
l4_steps.input: Draft schedule, airport slot files, gate lease agreements
l4_steps.output: Gate conflict report; slot confirmation list
l4_steps.kpi: Gate conflict resolution rate 100% before publication
l4_steps.pain_point: Slot-controlled airports (LGA, DCA, ORD) require separate coordination thread not integrated in SkyWORKS

l4_steps.name: Revenue Management Alignment Review
l4_steps.input: Draft schedule, fare basis files, historical close-in yield data
l4_steps.output: RM-approved schedule with fare class recommendations
l4_steps.kpi: Projected revenue within 2% of RM target per route
l4_steps.pain_point: Open boarding policy prevents seat-level RM; NRM implemented 2023, limited historical calibration data

l4_steps.name: Operations Control Sign-Off
l4_steps.input: Draft schedule, turn time analysis, ground time buffers
l4_steps.output: Ops-approved schedule with buffer recommendations
l4_steps.pain_point: Insufficient turn buffers at focus cities during peak — root cause of Dec 2022 cascade; mandatory 15-min buffer now enforced

l4_steps.name: Execute Aircraft-Crew Co-location Cross-Check
l4_steps.input: Fleet rotation plan, crew pairing plan
l4_steps.output: Co-location validation report; flagged mismatches
l4_steps.pain_point: This step was absent pre-Dec 2022; now mandatory. AWS ↔ SkyWORKS API integration point is highest-risk interface

l4_steps.name: Finalise SSIM File
l4_steps.input: Approved schedule, all sign-offs
l4_steps.output: Final SSIM file for submission
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual SSIM field corrections common; no automated SSIM validator integrated in SkyWORKS

l4_steps.name: Submit to IATA & Slot Coordinators
l4_steps.input: Final SSIM file
l4_steps.output: Confirmed slot portfolio; IATA acknowledgement
l4_steps.kpi: 100% slot confirmations received before season open
l4_steps.pain_point: Slot portal fragmentation (each airport has own portal); no single submission hub for US domestic carriers

l4_steps.name: Load Schedule to Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Final SSIM file
l4_steps.output: Live schedule in reservations system; bookable inventory open
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa load process requires 48-hour lead; any late schedule changes must go through emergency change protocol

l4_steps.name: Publish to GDS & Direct Channels
l4_steps.system: Sabre GDS, Travelport GDS, Amadeus GDS, Southwest.com
l4_steps.input: Altéa live schedule
l4_steps.output: Bookable flights live across all channels
l4_steps.kpi: GDS availability sync within 4 hours of Altéa load
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS cache refresh lag causes brief price/availability discrepancies on channel-switch; SWABIZ corporate portal sync is independent step

l4_steps.name: Ingest Approved Season Schedule
l4_steps.input: Final SSIM file from NP-SP-01
l4_steps.output: Schedule loaded into SkyMAX optimisation engine
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of flights ingested without parse error
l4_steps.pain_point: SSIM format version mismatches between SkyWORKS export and SkyMAX import cause periodic re-loads

l4_steps.name: Load Fleet Availability & Maintenance Windows
l4_steps.input: Fleet register, maintenance plan, AOG reserve list
l4_steps.output: Available aircraft pool per date range
l4_steps.pain_point: MRO system API to SkyMAX is custom-built and brittle; maintenance window changes often require manual SkyMAX refresh

l4_steps.name: Run Fleet Assignment Optimisation
l4_steps.input: Schedule, fleet pool, turn constraints, crew ratios
l4_steps.output: Initial fleet assignment: aircraft type per flight leg
l4_steps.kpi: Fleet utilisation ≥13 block hours/day; deadhead cost minimised
l4_steps.pain_point: Single fleet type removes payload/seat differentiation lever; optimisation is purely rotation-cost and utilisation-based

l4_steps.name: Validate Turn Time Feasibility
l4_steps.input: Fleet assignment, ground time per station, gate data
l4_steps.output: Turn time feasibility report; flagged short-turns
l4_steps.kpi: 0 turns below minimum turn time (25 min domestic / 35 min focus city)
l4_steps.pain_point: Post-Dec 2022: minimum turn time floor is now hard-coded constraint. Pre-2022, planners could override — this is now blocked

l4_steps.name: Generate Tail Routing Plan
l4_steps.input: Validated fleet assignment
l4_steps.output: Day-of-week rotation plan: tail number per flight sequence
l4_steps.pain_point: 737-700 vs 737-800 capacity difference (143 vs 175) must align with demand forecast by leg — manual override common for thin markets

l4_steps.name: Cross-Check Crew-Aircraft Co-location
l4_steps.input: Tail routing plan, crew pairing plan
l4_steps.output: Co-location validation report
l4_steps.pain_point: AWS ↔ SkyMAX API integration is the highest-risk interface in the planning stack; mismatch was root cause of Dec 2022 cascade

l4_steps.name: Maintenance Routing Alignment
l4_steps.input: Tail routing plan, scheduled maintenance events
l4_steps.output: Maintenance-aligned routing; tails routed through maintenance bases on correct nights
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of A-checks aligned to correct overnight station
l4_steps.pain_point: Phoenix heavy-check facility (expanded 2024) has limited line maintenance overnight slots; routing must account for bay capacity

l4_steps.name: Stress-Test with IRROP Scenarios
l4_steps.input: Tail routing plan, historical weather/ATC disruption data
l4_steps.output: IRROP resilience score; recovery playbooks per disruption type
l4_steps.kpi: Recovery plan covers top-10 disruption scenarios; recovery time <3 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Cairo AI tool provides cancellation recommendations in real IRROP but is not integrated into planning-phase stress testing

l4_steps.name: Operations Control Final Approval
l4_steps.input: Stress-tested routing plan, all validation reports
l4_steps.output: Ops-approved tail routing plan
l4_steps.pain_point: VP sign-off is a single point of failure; no documented deputy approval authority

l4_steps.name: Publish Routing to Crew & MRO Systems
l4_steps.system: SkyMAX → Crew Management System (AWS), Custom MRO System
l4_steps.input: Approved tail routing plan
l4_steps.output: Routing published to downstream systems
l4_steps.pain_point: Publish is a multi-system broadcast; AWS and MRO system do not share a common event bus — sequential API calls, no rollback if one fails

l4_steps.name: Archive Plan & Update Capacity Model
l4_steps.input: Final routing plan, utilisation actuals from prior season
l4_steps.output: Archived rotation file; updated capacity baseline model
l4_steps.pain_point: S3 data lake schema changes (12x faster processing post-AWS migration) require periodic re-mapping of archive tooling
